description: A C# game engine in which a program opens a window, draws each frame with plain static calls named as raylib's functions are, and draws Dear ImGui in the same frame, over SDL3, Vulkan and Slang, with an ECS and source-generated behaviors underneath.
releaseNotes:
A pixel whose screen probes stand on a surface like its own for under a quarter of their weight takes the world's probes' light by its shortfall, and the bounce rooms' bounds for the first view at Medium, the third, fourth, seventh and eighth at Medium and High move to 15% over their readings with it, 0.085, 0.263 and 0.142, 0.103 and 0.092, 0.034 and 0.031, 0.073 and 0.067, where without it the seventh at both and the eighth at Medium read 0.041, 0.041 and 0.085 over theirs.
Sponza's example turns its camera a set angle a frame on command, and build/flicker.py carries each picture of such a turn into the next before it counts what moved.
title: 3DEngine
